deficiencies.description: The rewrite resolves the lecturer's pointing words ('the tumor is here. This is the outer surface of the uterus') into a specific spatial description ('The tumour lies next to the outer surface of the uterus') that the lecturer did not state.
deficiencies.sourcePassage: You can see that the tumor is here. This is the outer surface of the uterus.
deficiencies.rewritePassage: The tumour lies next to the outer surface of the uterus

deficiencies.description: The rewrite changes the term 'circumspect' to 'circumscribed'. While 'circumscribed' is likely the intended term, it was not provided in the corrections list, making this an unauthorized change of term.

considerations.reason: The use of 'therefore' in the rewrite reflects the causal/consequential link drawn by the lecturer ('has actually caused... So you can see again that this is').
